thread:
anya: Quick heads-up — opened a docs PR fixing a KPI rename and a cost widget mismatch in the Console docs. Also found the Rust telemetry example uses the old header name and fails smoke tests. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/789 Can someone take a quick look? cc @kevin @tom

docs-bot: PR 789 created by @anya — presubmit started, link checks queued.

kevin: I can pick this up in ~1h. Which dashboards/panels are broken?

anya: Mainly the 'Cost by route' preset and the 'Avg latency vs tokens' dashboard. I renamed metric in the examples from `cost_per_request` -> `cost_per_unit` in the YAML, but the panel formulas still reference the old key so numbers look 100x off for some routes.

tom: For the Rust SDK failing test — can you paste the snippet here or point me to the file? I can run a quick smoke test locally.

anya: snippet is in docs/sdks/rust/telemetry.md — current example: ```rust
let client = TelemetryClient::new("X-TELEMETRY-KEY", std::env::var("TELEMETRY_KEY")?);
client.send_event("tokens_generated", tokens_count).await?;
```
Should be updated to use `Telemetry-Auth` header and env var `REDWOOD_TELEMETRY_KEY`.

prashant: Small follow-up suggestion: update dashboard formulas to `sum(cost_per_unit)` and add a migration helper in the example that converts legacy dashboards: `cost_per_request * tokens_per_request -> cost_per_unit`. I can push a tiny commit to the PR to adjust panels and add the conversion note.

lia: Also note the Console presets use metric aliasing; we should add an explicit alias mapping in the migration guide so existing customers' dashboards don't break after the docs rename. I'll add a short migration subsection and a screenshot.

kevin: Sounds good. Once prashant's patch lands and CI is green I'll merge. Any other failing examples?

anya: Node and Python snippets are fine. Rust was the only failing one due to header/env mismatch. I also found one broken internal link to the presets page — lint flagged it.

docs-bot: presubmit passed for md-lint and linkcheck flagged `docs/console/presets.md#old-anchor` as 404.

tom: Tested prashant's local patch against the Rust example — fixed the header/env and tests pass locally. :thumbsup:

lia: I'll add the alias table and a short note on unit conversions in the migration guide. Will also include a before/after screenshot of the 'Cost by route' panel.

kevin: Thanks everyone — quick follow-ups: @anya update the permalinks in the PR, @prashant push your panel patch, @lia add migration note. We should do a small post-merge announcement in #docs once this goes live to avoid surprised users.

anya: Will do — thanks all!
